Creates community-default seating objects when missing: PER-DEFAULT-OPERATOR,

PER-DEFAULT-AGENT, and ASK-DEFAULT-FEED-CORRESPONDENCE (templates under

scripts/default_personas and scripts/default_agent_skills). Same pack as

greenfield system init. Idempotent: skips ids that already exist.

Writes promote-ready (approved) objects onto CAS (not draft plane) so

feed ack/steer --persona-ref resolves.

  Repair missing default seating after scrub / incomplete init
  zqk system seed-default-agent-seating
  JSON result for agents
  zqk system seed-default-agent-seating --format json

Usage:
  zqk system seed-default-agent-seating [flags]

Flags:
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
